questions.title: Who will Morocco's king appoint as prime minister following the country's 2026 parliamentary election?
questions.background: Morocco's prime minister leads the government and is appointed by the king.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The Moroccan royal palace's public announcement, as documented in reliable news reporting. Resolution Condition : Resolve to the first person appointed prime minister and tasked with forming a government following Morocco's 2026 parliamentary election. Accepted Answer Format : The appointee's name or commonly used surname.
questions.current_reasoning: MAJOR 2026-09-27 BREAKING SIGNAL: Established Moroccan news outlet Al Ayam 24 (alayam24.com, published Sunday Sept 27 at 18:36) published an exclusive citing informed sources that King Mohammed VI has chosen PAM collective-leadership National Coordinator Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri as Prime Minister, that the Royal Cabinet notified her today (Sept 27), and that the King is expected to receive her tomorrow (Monday Sept 28) at the Royal Palace in Rabat to task her with forming the government. This aligns cleanly with Morocco's 3-for-3 post-2011 constitutional precedent of appointing the winning party's formal head (PAM confirmed #1 with 97/395 seats in Friday Sept 25 final Interior Ministry results, locking an Article 47 PAM appointee), the historic symbolism of Morocco's first female PM, and the political logic of keeping Fouzi Lekjaa (who only joined PAM in July and did not run for an MP seat) focused on Budget/FRMF/2030 World Cup after youth 'hospitals not stadiums' protests. However, because the Royal Cabinet/MAP has NOT yet issued an official announcement—and Morocco World News (Sept 27) reports that separate Sunday rumors falsely claiming Justice Minister/former PAM leader Abdellatif Ouahbi had been appointed were dismissed by Ouahbi as 'nonsense'—we strictly cap El Mansouri below 0.65 rather than overreacting to an unconfirmed single-outlet palace leak: shifting Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri 0.41 -> 0.63 (#1), trimming Fouzi Lekjaa 0.45 -> 0.28 (#2, still a strong fallback if the leak proves premature/wrong), Mohamed Mehdi Bensaid 0.08 -> 0.05, Younes Sekkouri 0.03 -> 0.02, and Abdellatif Ouahbi unchanged at 0.01 (residual 0.01 for other PAM figures like Fatima Saadi).

questions.title: Who will Aston Martin announce as Lance Stroll's teammate for the 2027 Formula One season?
questions.background: Aston Martin has not yet confirmed its complete race-driver lineup for the 2027 Formula One season.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Aston Martin's official announcement confirming its complete race-driver lineup for the 2027 Formula One season, corroborated by Formula One or reputable news reporting. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the driver named alongside Lance Stroll in the first such announcement published by December 31, 2026. A confirmed race-seat contract is sufficient; the driver need not have competed in a 2027 race. Reserve, test, and advisory roles do not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The driver's full name.
